name: point_black
story_seed:
ALONE AGAINST THE DARK - Point Black Lighthouse

    You arrive at the remote Point Black Lighthouse on the rocky Maine coast.
    Lieutenant Warner called you: the lighthouse keeper has vanished.
    But when you examine the logs, something is wrong. The keeper was dead for two weeks
    before anyone found him—yet someone has been writing in the logs ever since.

    The fog rolls in. The light blinks red. Something ancient stirs beneath the waves.
description:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ALONE AGAINST THE DARK - Point Black Lighthouse Adventure
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

SETTING:
You are at Point Black Lighthouse on the remote Maine coast. The lighthouse
stands on black rock, surrounded by crashing Atlantic waves and fog. A keeper
vanished 2 weeks ago under mysterious circumstances.

THE MYSTERY:
- The lighthouse keeper disappeared without explanation
- His final logbook entries became increasingly erratic: "They call from below"
- Strange sounds heard at night from the ocean
- Evidence of a pre-human fissure beneath the lighthouse
- Symbols cover the keeper's quarters - alien geometry that hurts to look at
- The lighthouse may have been built to CONTAIN something, not protect FROM it

KEY LOCATIONS:
- Lighthouse Exterior: Rocky black stone, salt spray, fog, weathered structure
- Keeper's Quarters: Sparse furniture, dust, decay smell, chemical odor
- Lighthouse Interior: Spiral stairs, damp, strange luminescent fungus (glow green)
- Lantern Room: Top of lighthouse, beacon lamp, ancient symbols, wide ocean view
- Ground Floor: Solid stone, darkness, echoing sounds
- Lighthouse Stairs: Iron spiral, flickering light, salt smell

KEY CHARACTERS:
- Lieutenant Warner (Coast Guard) - Knows keeper vanished, organized search
- Dr. Armitage (Professor) - Expert on pre-human symbols, ancient languages
- Chief Marsh (Police Chief) - Skeptical, pragmatic, wants mundane explanation

THE THREAT:
Something ancient lies beneath the ocean. It may be waking. The lighthouse
has contained it for centuries, but something has changed. The fissure is
becoming active. Reality is becoming thin around this place.

YOUR OBJECTIVE:
Uncover what happened to the keeper. Understand the nature of the threat.
Decide: Escape? Seal the fissure? Destroy the lighthouse? Confront the entity?
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

story_seed_i18n.es:
SOLO CONTRA LA OSCURIDAD — El Faro de Point Black

Llegas al remoto faro de Point Black, en la costa rocosa de Maine.
El teniente Warner te llamó: el farero ha desaparecido.
Pero al examinar los registros, algo no encaja. El farero llevaba dos semanas muerto
cuando lo encontraron... y sin embargo, alguien ha seguido escribiendo en el diario desde entonces.

La niebla avanza. La luz parpadea en rojo. Algo antiguo se agita bajo las olas.

locations.name: Point Black Lighthouse - Exterior
locations.description: A weathered lighthouse stands on rocky black stone, its paint peeling from decades of exposure to salt spray and Atlantic winds. The structure is perhaps thirty feet tall, surrounded by a low stone wall. The keeper's cottage sits nearby, its windows dark and empty.

locations.name: Keeper's Quarters
locations.description: The keeper's sparse living space: a cot, a table with a single chair, shelves of maritime equipment. Everything is covered in dust. Through the single window, you can see the lighthouse. There's a faint smell of decay and something else—something chemical.

locations.name: Lighthouse Interior
locations.description: The interior of the lighthouse is a spiral of iron stairs ascending into darkness. The air is thick and stale. Each step groans under your weight. The walls are covered in moisture and a strange luminescent fungus that glows faintly green in the darkness.

locations.name: Keeper's Room - Lighthouse Top
locations.description: At the top of the lighthouse, a small room contains a cot, desk, and the great lamp mechanism. Papers are scattered everywhere—logbooks, journals, sketches of impossible symbols. The light mechanism hasn't been lit in weeks. Through the windows, you can see the entire rocky coast and far out to sea.

locations.name: Lantern Room
locations.description: The glass-walled crown of the lighthouse. The great beacon lamp sits cold and dark, its lenses filmed with salt. Ancient symbols have been scratched into the brass fittings—recent work, done with a shaking hand. Through the panes, the ocean stretches gray and endless, and something about the horizon looks subtly wrong.

locations.name: Lighthouse Stairs
locations.description: An iron spiral staircase winds up through the tower's throat. Each step rings hollow and the whole structure trembles faintly in the wind. The lamps here flicker though no draft moves, and the smell of salt gives way to something older—brine and rot from somewhere far below.

locations.name: Ground Floor
locations.description: The base of the tower: solid stone walls a yard thick, a packed-earth floor, coils of rope and rusted tools. Sounds echo strangely here, arriving a half-second late, as if the room were larger than its walls. A cold draft seeps up from between the flagstones.

locations.name: Upper Level
locations.description: A cramped landing below the lantern room, cluttered with supply crates and oil cans. The window is small and rimed with salt. From here the stairs continue up toward the light—and someone has painted a crude warding symbol on the underside of the hatch above.

locations.name: Basement
locations.description: A low-ceilinged cellar cut into the living rock beneath the lighthouse. Barrels of lamp oil line one wall, furred with mold. The air is wet and mineral. In the far corner, the floor has been dug up—recently—and the exposed stone beneath bears a hairline crack that weeps seawater, though you are well above the tide line.

locations.name: Hidden Chamber
locations.description: A space that should not exist, sealed behind the basement wall. The chamber is older than the lighthouse—far older. Its walls are covered in carved symbols that hurt to follow, geometry that folds back on itself. At its center, the fissure: a black seam in the rock, breathing cold air that smells of the deep ocean. The keeper's final logbook lies open beside it.

warner.name: Lt. William Warner
knows_secret: I saw something in the water two months ago. Unnatural. Not a whale, not a fish.
The keeper's name was Marinus Weld. He was afraid of something specific... kept muttering about 'the deep'.
warner.personality: professional but visibly shaken, trying to maintain composure

armitage.name: Dr. Henry Armitage
knows_secret: I've decoded part of the inscription. It's a warning, not a seal. The seal was never completed.
The lighthouse wasn't built to protect anything from us. It was built to contain something beneath the ocean. To keep it sleeping.
armitage.personality: academic, grave, speaks in measured tones

safe_route.label: Find a safe route from the exterior (Navigate)

beacon_symbols.label: Understand the beacon symbols (Occult in the lantern room)

fissure_studied.label: Understand the fissure (Occult in the hidden chamber)

foundation_survey.label: Survey the foundations (Investigate in the basement)

shore_search.label: Search the exterior for the keeper key (Spot Hidden)

narrative.en: You follow the route you charted through the rocks. The lighthouse fades behind the fog. You have escaped, but its red light follows you in memory.
narrative.es: Sigues la ruta que trazaste entre las rocas. El faro se pierde tras la niebla. Has escapado, pero su luz roja te sigue en la memoria.

narrative.en: You understand what took the keeper and what waits beneath the light. With open eyes, you accept the change. The fissure answers, and the last warmth of your human life slips away.
narrative.es: Comprendes qué se llevó al farero y qué espera bajo la luz. Con los ojos abiertos, aceptas el cambio. La fisura responde y el último calor de tu vida humana se apaga.

narrative.en: Knowing the foundations and the fissure beneath them, you place the charges and light the fuse. The tower breaks against the storm. Beneath the fallen stone, the black seam closes. For now.
narrative.es: Conoces los cimientos y la fisura que yace bajo ellos. Colocas las cargas y enciendes la mecha. La torre se quiebra contra la tormenta. Bajo la piedra caída, la grieta negra se cierra. Por ahora.

finding.en: You chart a safe route through the coastal rocks. You can choose to leave the island from the exterior: leave the island.
Beneath a loose stone by the entrance lies the keeper's key. It opens the keeper's quarters. Collect it with: take keeper key.

The keeper's records describe a transformation tied to the beacon and the fissure below. Study the beacon symbols in the lantern room. The quarters also hold holy water and an ammunition cache; the keeper's logbook remains in the upper keeper room.

You trace a sealed passage beneath the foundations. Understanding the beacon symbols will let you open it into the hidden chamber. A dry recess here holds dynamite: take dynamite. To destroy the source, first study the beacon and the fissure, then return here.

The beacon symbols reveal how to open the passage in the basement once its foundations have been surveyed. An ancient text rests here: take ancient text. Return through the stairs and ground floor to reach the basement.

You understand the fissure. With the keeper's evidence and beacon symbols, you can choose transformation here: embrace the transformation. Alternatively, with dynamite and a foundation survey, return to the basement and choose: detonate the dynamite.
